stem.text: There is a current in a resistor for an unknown time.
Which two quantities can be used to calculate the energy dissipated by the resistor?

A.text: the current in the resistor and the potential difference across the resistor

B.text: the resistance of the resistor and the current in the resistor

C.text: the total charge passing through the resistor and the potential difference across the resistor

D.text: the total charge passing through the resistor and the resistance of the resistor
